title: Mission picker barrel: Custom Scenarios shift and Campaign centring (2026-11-05)

facts.title: The mission picker barrel moves 50 units right only on Custom Scenarios
facts.fact: ma2_pc_menu_pulse calls ma2_barrel_offset(50) on every menu pulse when the menu vtable is 0x48F3E0 (the mission picker) and Custom Scenarios mode is on (ma2_scn_custom_active), and ma2_barrel_offset(0) everywhere else. The 50 640x480 units make room for the Scenario Editor button drawn to the left (EDITOR_X0.X1 = 65.113). place_one -> shift_barrel moves the barrel title and its text children (the description); the arrows are re-placed from the barrel every frame.

facts.title: Bug: Campaign level select stayed shifted right after visiting Custom Scenarios
facts.fact: The Campaign mission picker's level selector was off centre, shifted right as if the Editor button were there. Root cause: shift_widget only ever added the offset, and with the offset back at 0 shift_barrel returned early, so nothing moved the widgets back. The Campaign picker reuses the Custom Scenarios barrel widget, so it kept the +50 x at +0x4C and +0x5C. Fix (the game source tree, ma2_bots_ui.c, on top of e4a03a9): each tracked widget stores its base x and the offset applied (g_shifted[16]: w, x[2], dx); when the offset changes, including back to 0, x is rewritten to base + new offset. g_shifted_live counts entries still offset, so with offset 0 shift_barrel does nothing unless a shifted widget needs restoring. A widget whose +0x4C no longer equals base + applied is treated as new and re-based.
facts.how_to_use: Open Custom Scenarios (selector shifted right, Editor button on the left), back out to the hub, open Campaign: the level selector must be centred.

facts.title: Custom Scenarios mode ends when any other hub item is chosen
facts.fact: ma2_scn_hub_action calls ma2_scn_custom_leave for every hub action except 8 (Custom Scenarios), so the Campaign picker sees ma2_scn_custom_active == 0, gets barrel offset 0 and shows no Editor button. The mode is not ended when the hub is merely rebuilt (quitting a custom mission passes through the hub on the way back to the picker).

facts.title: Centring fix shipped to PC Release on 2026-11-05 (exe 1446948D.8800)
facts.fact: build-\mechassault2_recomp.exe with the shift_widget restore was built (only ma2_bots_ui.c recompiled) and copied to PC Release as 'MechAssault 2.exe' with mechassault2_recomp.map. SHA-256 1446948DD3B1E970A832F2DF19DAB7E012EEA1979CAF26CC8D4D1517E45A8800. It is v13au28 (A046C9FC.62E4, a test folder, 11-05, the Bots audit build) plus this fix; v13au28 itself does NOT have the fix. Not yet checked in-game at the time of writing.
